newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zuerich names Rohrbasser as new cfo.
newsitem.headline: Zuerich names Rohrbasser as new cfo.

text.p: The board of directors of Zurich Insurance Co. has appointed Markus Rohrbasser as member of the corporate executive board and group chief financial officer from January 1, 1997, the company said in a statement.
Rohrbasser joins Zuerich Insurance from Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS), where he most recently was a member of the enlarged corporate executive board and chief executive for UBS in North America.

Rohrbasser, borne in 1954, will replace Rolf Haenggi, who announced in September that he would resign from Zurich in the first half of 1997. Haenggi has been chief financial officer of Zurich since 1987.
Rohrbasser grew up in the city of Zurich and began his professional career in the Capital Market Switzerland section of UBS after completing his studies at University of California, Berkley.
Zurich's board also named Laurence Cheng, born in 1947, to the executive board and as chief investment officer.

Cheng, a Canadian who began his studies in Hong Kong, joined Zurich in 1975 and his most recent position was as chief executive of Zurich Investment Management in Chicago, responsible for Institutional Asset Management at Zurich Kemper Investments in the U.S.
Zurich's board also named Richerd Johnson, head of corporate risk management, and Daniel Villiger, head of corprate development, to the enlarged executive board.
